fixture.product_path: authenticated OpenSSH SessionExec of the image-pinned case-filter command

qemu-virt.budget_use: forbidden; QEMU ticks are not converted, combined, or compared with the physical-Duo budget

sampling.order: three discarded warmups followed by twenty-one retained samples on each cold boot

statistics.p50: nearest-rank index ceil(0.50*n)-1 after ascending sort
statistics.p95: nearest-rank index ceil(0.95*n)-1 after ascending sort

phases.boundary: after authenticated SessionExec(case-filter) acceptance through exact credential, policy, manifest, image-root, and plan revalidation, including validator/compiler work and excluding Core/adapter instruction execution
owner, arena, CSpace, task envelope, ProfileEngine, SynchronousComponent, ResourceTable, and typed-call construction
Canonical lower/lift, realloc, resource-token, return-pointer, and value encoding/decoding
only wasmi Core or adapter instruction execution; validation and compilation are excluded
runnable stream read/write/close and SSH pump/protocol transport work
yield, HostPending, backpressure, scheduler, and network waiting
after guest Ready or trap through terminal/stream finalization, CSpace/registry/arena/owner reclaim, VSH reaper acknowledgement, and stdout drain

framing.raw_scope: one independently booted physical Milk-V Duo session
framing.boot_index_binding: host evidence assigns boot_index 0 through 2 after independent raw verification; target records contain no boot index

run_id.encoding: domain followed by fields as NUL-separated ASCII values with no trailing NUL
run_id.meaning: shared campaign identity only; it does not prove a cold boot

sample_suffix_words: stdout_sha256 as four big-endian u64 words
accumulator.purpose: ordered truncation and corruption check, not authentication

decision_rule.preconditions: C8.3 is complete and every C8.4 publication gate passes on the eligible physical-Duo dataset
decision_rule.candidate_outcome: only when both predicates are true, AOT becomes eligible for C8.5 design review
decision_rule.otherwise: AOT is not justified for ssh-case-filter-12k-v1
decision_rule.authorization: no outcome here authorizes JIT, RWX, external native bytes, or bypass of authoritative component bytes, profile, WIT, CSpace, and admission policy

publication_gates.precondition: C8.3 fixed-QEMU and three-cold-boot physical-Duo publication is complete
publication_gates.identity: source commit, manifest, schema, artifact, WAT, input, output, command, world, entrypoint, image policy, and platform envelope match exactly
publication_gates.completeness: three independently verified single-cold-boot raw transcripts each contain one META, exactly three warmups then twenty-one retained samples, and one END; host evidence binds distinct boot indexes 0 through 2
publication_gates.correctness: every sample exits zero, emits the exact 12325-byte output hash, emits empty stderr, consumes 1 through 500000 fuel, and reports positive poll quanta
publication_gates.successful_samples_only: timed-out, trapped, failed, truncated, or otherwise non-successful attempts are diagnostic records outside the formal dataset and can never authorize AOT
publication_gates.phase_partition: intervals are non-empty, ordered, gap-free, non-overlapping, and labeled with exactly one of seven phases; adjacent intervals have different phases; total_ticks equals both the response interval and the sum of phase_ticks
publication_gates.interval_capacity: every formal sample pins interval_capacity to 65536, requires interval_count == len(intervals), and sets intervals_complete true; interval overflow or truncation is diagnostic-only and cannot enter the decision population
publication_gates.duo_stability: within each boot retained p95(total_ticks) divided by p50(total_ticks) is at most 1.50
publication_gates.qemu_exclusion: QEMU records are integration-only and absent from every budget and attribution statistic
publication_gates.preparation_only: this manifest contains no measurement result and does not complete C8.3 or authorize AOT
